summary: NovaBridge Biosciences filed a Form 6-K to disclose a change in its independent registered public accounting firm. The Audit Committee dismissed PricewaterhouseCoopers LLP (PwC) effective June 16, 2026, and appointed Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu Certified Public Accountants LLP for fiscal year 2026. PwC's reports for fiscal years 2024-2025 contained no adverse opinion or disagreements, though material weaknesses in ITGCs had been reported. No terms or deal mechanics apply. This auditor change is non-routine but constitutes a governance event, not a special situation category.
